import subprocess, time, json
commands = [
    ["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests/test_optimization_audit.py"],
    ["python3", "tools/optimization_audit.py", "--help"],
    ["python3", "tools/optimization_audit.py", "--mode", "template", "--output", ".gsd/milestones/M013/M013-AUDIT-TEMPLATE.md"],
]
results = []
for cmd in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    duration_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    results.append({
        "command": " ".join(cmd),
        "exitCode": proc.returncode,
        "durationMs": duration_ms,
        "stdout": proc.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if proc.stdout.strip() else "",
        "stderr": proc.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1] if proc.stderr.strip() else "",
    })
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
PY
